However, both medications carry risks after drinking, so neither is completely risk-free.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF16mUHhotiSJeyvVbBfNJkB8QsxrNEnolvZcqSY-yJixoEQwYeSkRYjpZbQ8Wk3L2cUOV9Rc4DTaTKsDwuuXWLV2ESgrLBybrbTQMX8U6jOoN2kn_onPsjP9DGzQjsnPXGpcEeYzloZ6R_wzPGlFsqL6H3vEKJ7L6mLRlw1zy8FOEUFmQZBfqJWWxIFYKYOfI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF13ePZlr72C8btTwZfI5ID9wOUuxtZ7LxTFN0fKoNITxSkfR9vQekXm5hVyhqRtSf5vxETeBj5y_HzfHa1nNqfw83N3vusQBvoSOyE4t5SdaCX4_IKrUvHmmgRd20hTs63OAB1JaadotUDYaqUanRceoLmwBF2hjgW3LL0vcg7teTEC6okpWvxSXsOJYc)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX0hgsWG0f0pSEpLbc-t623YW0YNeNGuLkOmpDXQ-D1Thk2T14XApIgsP_AgDG-hD44_j_xkqN95HRXjhbku9Txd2BDULStSTKK-bdupyohC42OCitC5YSLw9RH566HITGvDVHfWjuhuk86qwKHg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF155WNLnuw6xniBhLNmdMZKQDoRPbD1yfrfB0P-t2wAPi1C_VnJ8Mz4vNRxa-n2RJ0bXY-IICnSSAtJaxQyiaapKFWVu7eyWao9VFiYnxEtrs03dBitDNJDVrXMe_MYPDBR9eRTlEcqZd4aWCDG77T4twsDNMdLMCVKY_sQ)

### Advil (Ibuprofen)

- **Pros:** Targets inflammation and helps ease hangover headaches and body aches without adding strain to the liver.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF13ePZlr72C8btTwZfI5ID9wOUuxtZ7LxTFN0fKoNITxSkfR9vQekXm5hVyhqRtSf5vxETeBj5y_HzfHa1nNqfw83N3vusQBvoSOyE4t5SdaCX4_IKrUvHmmgRd20hTs63OAB1JaadotUDYaqUanRceoLmwBF2hjgW3LL0vcg7teTEC6okpWvxSXsOJYc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX0hgsWG0f0pSEpLbc-t623YW0YNeNGuLkOmpDXQ-D1Thk2T14XApIgsP_AgDG-hD44_j_xkqN95HRXjhbku9Txd2BDULStSTKK-bdupyohC42OCitC5YSLw9RH566HITGvDVHfWjuhuk86qwKHg)
- **Cons & Risks:** Can irritate your stomach lining—especially when alcohol has already irritated it—and may affect the kidneys or cause stomach bleeding in some people.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXqpcE8XfxiWeJm2SOM7XnCpHY7jAHzmQiybmZyg14HnMqnxYdJdCHzpscQ7K0yZIsm4hc6o2tjSx43vW5VXH4aDGy9Xxkg4CDq330-ruNymtJ_Dl4CnQFV59FWvMiaBMyi6nOhDv9V7d2u8SXcnNR)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF13ePZlr72C8btTwZfI5ID9wOUuxtZ7LxTFN0fKoNITxSkfR9vQekXm5hVyhqRtSf5vxETeBj5y_HzfHa1nNqfw83N3vusQBvoSOyE4t5SdaCX4_IKrUvHmmgRd20hTs63OAB1JaadotUDYaqUanRceoLmwBF2hjgW3LL0vcg7teTEC6okpWvxSXsOJYc)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXxgDXJ7xGPFRUsytns33hV61lVFg_pZsVeMy7VNPpn1qoepizC9y0UlqB47p9unhugMPgwKmRB4fFZRbqxeHh_hMAE9AVAVuiScehvD515khl82V_dTZPiOuzVyIJrhzxQg)
- **How to use more safely:** Take it with food and plenty of water after you stop drinking, and avoid it if you have stomach ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, or kidney issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF155WNLnuw6xniBhLNmdMZKQDoRPbD1yfrfB0P-t2wAPi1C_VnJ8Mz4vNRxa-n2RJ0bXY-IICnSSAtJaxQyiaapKFWVu7eyWao9VFiYnxEtrs03dBitDNJDVrXMe_MYPDBR9eRTlEcqZd4aWCDG77T4twsDNMdLMCVKY_sQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXqpcE8XfxiWeJm2SOM7XnCpHY7jAHzmQiybmZyg14HnMqnxYdJdCHzpscQ7K0yZIsm4hc6o2tjSx43vW5VXH4aDGy9Xxkg4CDq330-ruNymtJ_Dl4CnQFV59FWvMiaBMyi6nOhDv9V7d2u8SXcnNR)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX0hgsWG0f0pSEpLbc-t623YW0YNeNGuLkOmpDXQ-D1Thk2T14XApIgsP_AgDG-hD44_j_xkqN95HRXjhbku9Txd2BDULStSTKK-bdupyohC42OCitC5YSLw9RH566HITGvDVHfWjuhuk86qwKHg)

### Tylenol (Acetaminophen)

- **Pros:** Does not cause the same direct stomach lining irritation as NSAIDs like ibuprofen.
- **Cons & Risks:** Mixing alcohol with acetaminophen can cause serious liver toxicity, as both are processed through the liver. Medical guidance from sources like [Mayo Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF16mUHhotiSJeyvVbBfNJkB8QsxrNEnolvZcqSY-yJixoEQwYeSkRYjpZbQ8Wk3L2cUOV9Rc4DTaTKsDwuuXWLV2ESgrLBybrbTQMX8U6jOoN2kn_onPsjP9DGzQjsnPXGpcEeYzloZ6R_wzPGlFsqL6H3vEKJ7L6mLRlw1zy8FOEUFmQZBfqJWWxIFYKYOfI) and [Harvard Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF13ePZlr72C8btTwZfI5ID9wOUuxtZ7LxTFN0fKoNITxSkfR9vQekXm5hVyhqRtSf5vxETeBj5y_HzfHa1nNqfw83N3vusQBvoSOyE4t5SdaCX4_IKrUvHmmgRd20hTs63OAB1JaadotUDYaqUanRceoLmwBF2hjgW3LL0vcg7teTEC6okpWvxSXsOJYc) warns against taking Tylenol when alcohol is in your system.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF16mUHhotiSJeyvVbBfNJkB8QsxrNEnolvZcqSY-yJixoEQwYeSkRYjpZbQ8Wk3L2cUOV9Rc4DTaTKsDwuuXWLV2ESgrLBybrbTQMX8U6jOoN2kn_onPsjP9DGzQjsnPXGpcEeYzloZ6R_wzPGlFsqL6H3vEKJ7L6mLRlw1zy8FOEUFmQZBfqJWWxIFYKYOfI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF13ePZlr72C8btTwZfI5ID9wOUuxtZ7LxTFN0fKoNITxSkfR9vQekXm5hVyhqRtSf5vxETeBj5y_HzfHa1nNqfw83N3vusQBvoSOyE4t5SdaCX4_IKrUvHmmgRd20hTs63OAB1JaadotUDYaqUanRceoLmwBF2hjgW3LL0vcg7teTEC6okpWvxSXsOJYc)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXRqCPHAYB3IQDNLlGUcQHt7Nor9eO9n9IrtPS27gXyRIDTC0oR-uxKgD4XhKAHZwGxM6xIX4yxW7Mtpm2A45dSOTq7D6JdQZuOsO0R_8imPbGo1ctXtJ8Y18M02fLI7mY)
